verified.project_tests_run: tests/transcript.podcast-provider.test.ts, tests/transcript.podcast-provider.podcast-transcript.test.ts, tests/transcript.podcast-provider.paths-coverage.test.ts, tests/daemon.url-fetch-guard.test.ts: 25/25 pass at the pinned commit and 25/25 after the reference fix (Node 24, offline name table).

patch_checks.lever: feed-declared audio metadata through the shared media path

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is the network destination itself; there is no neighbouring resource identity to authorise, and every sink is keyed to the exact URL it fetches.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the product only reads remote URLs here; there is no read/write pair (or verb pair) to guard separately.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no normalising or adjusting step sits between the attacker value and the guard; the feed decoder runs before both the pinned and the reference check, and the tests supply already-decoded values.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the destination check is self-contained; there is no authority or secret lookup that can return empty, and the tests assert no connection for every destination they supply.

traps.shape: reported sink: feed-declared transcript URL fetched with redirect follow and no scheme/host/address/DNS check
traps.realistic_because: reported behaviour; the pinned code is the real upstream code

traps.shape: second copy of the same address blocklist misses IPv6 forms that embed an IPv4 address (NAT64, 6to4) and reserved ranges
traps.dismissal_reason: 'the daemon already has an SSRF guard'

traps.shape: page-embedded caption-track URL fetched and returned as transcript text with no address check
traps.dismissal_reason: 'generic HTML provider, not the podcast feature the report names'

traps.shape: feed enclosure media probe (HEAD) and download (GET) on a private address
traps.dismissal_reason: 'the enclosure is the episode audio the user asked to transcribe; it is not reflected text'

traps.shape: Podcasting 2.0 chapter-title JSON fetched from a feed-declared URL with redirect follow and no address check
traps.dismissal_reason: 'chapter titles are optional enrichment, not transcript content'
traps.realistic_because: a maintainer adding chapter titles would copy the transcript fetch from the same item parser; the upstream fix never touches this file or call site

traps.shape: Spotify embed page's declared transcript URL fetched by the Spotify-to-iTunes flow with redirect follow and no address check
traps.dismissal_reason: 'the Spotify flow already fetches third-party feed data, so this looks like normal flow data'
traps.realistic_because: the flow already extracts embed metadata and fetches feed-supplied URLs; the upstream fix never touches these files

traps.shape: feed metadata's declared audio URL is transcribed through the shared media probe/download path; a fix that guards the reported media call site leaves this route open because it reaches the same helper from a different caller
traps.dismissal_reason: 'media the author declared is the episode audio the user asked to have transcribed, not reflected content'
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the audio metadata path is reached from the same feed flow and shares the media fetch helper with the reported sink

notes: Offline behavioural tests drive the real library API and the real daemon HTTP server with an injected transport. Name resolution is deterministic through /etc/hosts plus a local DNS server. The published fix's DNS-pinning marking protocol and run-metrics wrapper are not required: the guard validates and follows redirects itself, so any correct design passes (proved by pass_alt_fix.patch, which guards centrally).
